note: Risk-only review. Sanctions: no confirmed hit found, but this is NOT a verified negative — the DuckDuckGo search backend was unreachable (connection refused) and the OFAC Sanctions List Search tool is JavaScript-driven and returned no queryable results, so OFAC SDN, UN, EU, UK and BIS Entity List screening could not be executed. sanctions_hit set to null (not public/not verifiable in this session) rather than asserting 'clean'. Court cases: Indian Kanoon search for 'Automotive Axles Limited' returned 199 documents; the 10 most relevant are listed above. Pattern is overwhelmingly (a) labour/service writ petitions where the company is the employer-petitioner, (b) indirect-tax (excise/customs) appeals from 1992-2003, and (c) a 2021-2022 civil dispute with Mullur Solar Parks (company appears on both sides of related proceedings). No criminal matters, no insolvency/NCLT proceedings, no sanctions-enforcement litigation surfaced in the first page of results; remaining ~189 documents not individually reviewed. Per project rule 2, these court matters are not rejection grounds and are recorded neutrally. Credit rating: null — CRISIL and other rating-agency pages could not be fetched (TLS handshake timeout), so no rating, rating date or outlook is asserted; the company is BSE-listed (scrip code 505010, page reachable but content not rendered) and ratings are likely public but were not retrievable here. Regulator actions / negative news: null — no news source could be queried (search backend down); nothing found, nothing invented. Overall: no rejection grounds identified under project rules; the gaps above are research-coverage gaps, not clean bills of health, and should be re-run once search and rating-agency access are restored.
